listing.name: Banana
listing.summary: Changes the default "missing ship" from a Nebula to a very conspicuous space fruit. Most useful for mod authors to see when they've screwed up.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces the default missing ship placeholder with a conspicuous space fruit.
